entry.author: 1News
entry.summary:
This weeks' ASB Good as Gold recipient is Mark Williams. For more than 25 years, Mark built and grew a Christmas lighting business renowned for its spectacular displays, charitable fundraising, and unwavering community spirit. Through his elaborate light installations, he has raised funds for countless charities, supported families in need, and inspired thousands of visitors each year. 

Mark is a tetraplegic due to an accident at the age of 16 and is now working for an innovative mobility solutions company to champion greater independence for people with disabilities. He has continued creating light displays from his own home, which bring endless visitors throughout the year. 

He is humble, thoughtful, and passionate about bringing joy to his community, which is why ASB is proud to recognise Mark Williams with $10,000 as this week's ASB Good as Gold recipient.
